title: Local provider roster entry and host-class configuration
description: Contract for the extended roster entry form used by the `local` provider in agent-coordinator/archetypes.yaml (design D4). Validation is enforced at coordinator startup: entries whose active_params_b exceeds the host-class ceiling, or dense entries (active_params_b == total_params_b) with total_params_b >= 30, are rejected with a structured configuration error.

model.description: Model identifier as served by the OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. served model name/alias).

active_params_b.description: Active parameters per token in billions. MUST be <= total_params_b and <= the host-class active-parameter ceiling.

reviewed.description: Operator sign-off date for this roster entry (roster entries rotate; the rule does not).

active_params_ceiling_b.description: Maximum active parameters (billions) a roster entry may declare on this bandwidth-bound host class. GB10 default: 12.

dense_params_limit_b.description: Dense entries (active == total) at or above this total size are rejected regardless of the active ceiling.

local_roster.description: Tier name -> roster entry. `standard` and `economy` are required for the local provider; omitted tiers resolve via graceful degradation.
